description: Final draft of the National Water Supply and Drainage Board (Amendment) Bill
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-12-01 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Taking into account the complex challenges and competitiveness that may arise in the future owing to the rapid urbanization, severe climatic changes, increasing consumer demand and the changes to be faced with the implementation of emerging digital technologies, approval of the Cabinet has been granted on 2024‑08‑12 to publish the National Water Supply and Drainage Board (Amendment) Bill, which has been prepared to adapt to address those challenges, in the Government Gazette and thereafter, present the same in Parliament, but, action could not be taken accordingly. Considering the need to expeditiously enact the said Bill for the efficient performance of the functions of the National Water Supply and Drainage Board, the proposal made by the Minister of Housing, Construction and Water Supply to publish the said Bill in the Government Gazette and thereafter present the same in Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.
